answer: Each identity registers a falcon and a nadir post, locks a 70-credit bond and files a sealed token the falcon carries down a spiral route per epoch. The post stamps the day code from the public schedule; an auditor recomputes the code and checks token serial, falcon serial, stamp. Wrong code, reused token, or shared falcon burns the bond. First filing 38, kth 38+6(k-1); 1000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-token ring fails: token serials bind to one key, the code rotates daily, and only a fresh spiral flight reaches the nadir post. Honest agents pay 38 once, bond refunded.
